decision: Do not publish isolated A/B savings as closure. Neither the current implementation nor these narrow candidates has demonstrated a complete return path within the retained 128-frame budget or the original time limits.
invariant_set: Original 128-frame counters, purpose-bound peer/pidfd and absolute session end remain unchanged.
S/Material Evidence and readiness <=500ms, original command caller timeouts and <=300s absolute lifetime remain unchanged; generic owner command allows <=30s independently.
No reconnect, endpoint substitution, counter pooling or new Source instance.
Every outer invocation independently reads real original owners before and after; no cached CURRENT or proof survives an invocation.
Original Source/Cell/Artifact/CURRENT/journal bytes continue to be physically read and compared at the required end of the operation.
Execute keeps its actual preclaim live reads, original NewWork/origin/clock checks, once-only consumption and original signing/FinalUse authority.
Readback/proof cannot create Fresh, Qualified adoption or generic issuer authority.
Cancellation, incomplete slot traversal or failed final read permanently invalidates that invocation proof.

cuts.present_call_sequence: Host read_panel_with_training(before) -> ReceiptOwner::readback -> authenticate_completed performs its own actual Trainer read -> Host read_panel_with_training(after) -> final actual receipt journal read -> proof.finish -> final signature authentication.
cuts.concrete_seam: A new private Host-only completed-Readback path may borrow the already admitted OriginalPanelTrainingReadV1, require its exact middle boundary and same actual Trainer/config, and provide the original verified immutable Training signature solely to authenticate_roles. The proof must also track consumption of this receipt slot; it cannot silently accept an omitted receipt operation.
cuts.preserved: The two existing real Trainer boundary reads remain at their actual panel positions; prepare/runner/Cell/Qualification and both journal reads remain. Existing public standalone readback, Individual mode and Execute use their existing paths.
cuts.no_free_signature_api: Do not expose a pub getter returning a SignedLearningEvidenceV1 as if it were a current owner read. The scoped receipt result is provisional and cannot escape until the original last panel read, journal equality and proof.finish all pass.
reject_examples: same bytes from different actual Trainer Arc
receipt operation before/after its one permitted boundary
Trainer withdrawal at final original read

cuts.present_call_sequence: Each uses full read_original before and after its same-call no-effect construction work; each full read_original itself contains two actual D/T/B cuts and physical artifact/phase reads.
cuts.concrete_seam: Split only the private mechanics of a full read_original into begin/observe/finish operations accepted by one private borrowed factory scope. Keep both real outer cut reads, every physical artifact/phase/Source/Cell/CURRENT read and full equality checks; inner immutable cut checks authenticate the exact expected pins without sending another original T/B request.
cuts.binding: Tie the scope to this host, exact retained state/cut, shared T/B client identities, purpose, absolute end and one call identity. No caller can construct it, reset it, serialize it or retain it in host state.
cuts.preserved: The separate actual live Selection/current call or S Evidence remains in the middle. C factory still pays its S Evidence's two T/B pairs. Recovered origins cannot create a fresh owner. Return actual owner only after the final physical checks and cancellation/lifetime gates.
reject_examples: different host or cut with equal receipt bytes
source/artifact/current withdrawal between middle and tail
cancel queued factory before first effect
attempt to retain token for a second factory

cuts.present_api_gap: NextUseSources::selector returns &LearningIterationEvidenceClientV1; predecessors calls its generic readback(snapshot, expected S). The actual S evidence handler receives bytes+request_id and performs its own readback_evaluated_remote_selection. No existing argument carries an unforgeable borrowed parent C invocation or proves that this S request belongs to the same common-predecessor window.
cuts.forbidden_shortcut: Neither the current signature, equal expected T/B pins, a caller bool, nor a global/thread-local current proof may suppress S's actual T/B reads. Existing S Evidence cannot be silently rebranded into a fresh or cross-call proof.
minimum_new_contract: Original consuming S/C factories establish an actual private relationship between the already held C->S evidence purpose and the exact shared original T/B owners; no extra endpoint or Source is created.
A single C outer call starts from actual T/B reads and owns a nonserializable or purpose-fixed strictly authenticated invocation context. Generic Evidence callers cannot enter this mode.
Both original S journal/Source/CURRENT reads still occur on the original S capability. Their full original signatures and expected predecessor pins must be returned from this invocation and checked.
The last actual T/B read must follow the last S I/O, then the original final C Source/Cell/journal checks must run. Otherwise the returned S result is not bracketed.
Exactly two S slots are accepted for the corresponding C call; wrong peer/pidfd/request/cut/order/time, overlap, unknown/cancelled/expired window or missing tail refuses.
No Trainer lane or MutexGuard may be held while making a recursive S/B request that needs the same lane.
No proof or owner decision escapes before the complete outer window closes; a public Readback result remains read-only.
cuts.conclusion: Even this larger unimplemented protocol would not close the same-host R=1 path by itself. Its hypothetical frame saving is not an authorization or execution proof.

R1_scenarios.scope: A plus B plus hypothetical C

residual_budget.post_A_B_target: With Readback=2 and one Execute=4, a same-host complete path needs at most 63 total B calls. A+B at R=1 still has 87 B calls, so 24 more B invocations must be eliminated inside legitimate same-invocation windows. Version-only needs 10 more Readback calls eliminated.
residual_budget.post_A_B_C_target: The hypothetical C cut still needs 8 further B-call savings at R=1 in the same-host assembly; a tiny extra local reduction is not assumed.
remaining_seams: A Root same-invocation complete original read vector may avoid independently rereading the same S/T/B that the actual C owner just validated. It needs a private typed response proving actual per-request observations, exact cut/nonce/peer and first/last sources; a copied receipt vector is insufficient.

Nested Version Prepare/publish cuts must be examined as effect boundaries. Original actual preclaim and post-effect checks, independent FinalUse, Unknown semantics and source withdrawal-before-effect behavior cannot be replaced by an earlier pin.
Issuer claim and pre-request checks occur in separate queued blocking closures with the Version mutex released before external Root I/O. Do not simply call them one readonly window.
residual_budget.explicit_no_closed_implementation: No complete safe same-host scheme has yet been implemented or independently checked for the remaining eight or twenty-four call savings, hidden setup frames, or 500ms/300s timing. Current source must not be labeled closed.
